name: measurableSet_lineDifferentiableAt
statement: Continuous f) : MeasurableSet {x : E | LineDifferentiableAt 𝕜 f x v}

name: measurable_lineDeriv
statement: Continuous f) : Measurable (fun x ↦ lineDeriv 𝕜 f x v)

name: stronglyMeasurable_lineDeriv
statement: Continuous f) : StronglyMeasurable (fun x ↦ lineDeriv 𝕜 f x v)

name: measurable_lineDeriv_uncurry

name: stronglyMeasurable_lineDeriv_uncurry
